# SEVASTOLINK Thank you for using Sevastolink, an LM-Link product for Seegson workstations.
- Double click an icon on the desktop to open it. - Drag a window by its title bar, resize it from the bottom right corner, double click the title to maximize. - ExtraNet connects you to colony services. Press DIR to list every node this terminal can reach. - POP OUT moves the browser to its own window.
Do not eat or drink at this terminal.
